description.en: Discover public holidays, national days, and regional observances in Sint Maarten. Plan your travels and schedule around the official holiday calendar.

sections.title: About Sint Maarten
sections.content: Sint Maarten has a unique calendar of public holidays that reflect its culture, history, and traditions. The local observances often include both national and regional celebrations.

sections.title: How Public Holidays Are Observed
sections.content: On public holidays in Sint Maarten, schools, government offices, and many private businesses are typically closed. Public transport may operate on a reduced schedule. Essential services remain operational.

q.en: Are shops open on public holidays in Sint Maarten?

a.en: Many large retail stores and supermarkets may operate on reduced hours, while smaller independent shops and local businesses usually close. It is advisable to check ahead.

q.en: How are weekends treated for holidays in Sint Maarten?

a.en: If a fixed-date public holiday falls on a weekend, Sint Maarten often provides a substitute day off on the following Monday, though this depends on the specific holiday laws.

q.en: Is public transport available on holidays?

a.en: Public transportation generally runs on a Sunday or holiday schedule, which means reduced frequency. It is recommended to check local transit websites before traveling.

q.en: What is the most significant holiday in Sint Maarten?

a.en: Major holidays usually include New Year's Day, religious observances like Christmas or Easter, and significant local national or territory days.
